review.scope: fifteen original right-facing Reed reverse-dunk poses, character identity, human anatomy, reverse finish, transparency and source isolation
review.notes: The edited transparent sheet preserves fifteen distinct complete Reed figures in 5-column by 3-row order. His right-facing approach transitions into a clear back three-quarter turn; the invisible ball gathers behind the crown, then the wrists snap backward for the reverse release and finish before he unwinds to a two-foot landing. His medium-brown skin, goatee, attached purple-black braided topknot, natural human anatomy, blank purple/gold Condas uniform, white lower-leg wear and purple/gold shoes remain consistent. White-ground source and dark/light atlas review found no clipping or visible red/coral fringe outside the dark outlines. Standard and zoom120 native gameplay captures place the separate ball at the waist hands, behind the crown and close to the backward release hands. All fifteen frames select from the registered production atlas in both facings; the ball stays carried through tick20 and releases at tick21. J.01 approves safe mirroring.
